name: partner-statement
title: Partner review statement
for_each: select id,name from partners order by name

sections.title: Partner record
sections.sql: select name,owner,agreement_ref,review_on from partners where id=$1

sections.title: Reviewed amounts by currency
sections.note: Working record only. Excludes open disputes and unreviewed conversions. Confirm terms and merchant records before any payment.
sections.sql: select currency,conversions,pending,approved_payout_cents,approved_margin_cents,pending_payout_cents from partner_balances where partner_id=$1 order by currency

sections.title: Conversion detail
sections.sql: select source_event_id,offer,source_status,decision,disputed,currency,revenue_cents,payout_cents from conversion_review where partner_id=$1 order by source_event_id

name: decision-record
title: Conversion decision record
for_each: select id,source_event_id name from conversions order by source_event_id

sections.title: Decision history
sections.sql: select decision,operator,reason,evidence_ref,created_at from decisions where conversion_id=$1 order by created_at,id

name: disclosure-register
title: Partner disclosure evidence register
for_each: select id,name from partners order by name

sections.title: Recorded inspections
sections.note: A recorded clear outcome is a human assessment, not legal certification. Earlier inspections are retained.
sections.sql: select placement,market,outcome,evidence_ref,checked_on,review_on from disclosures where partner_id=$1 order by checked_on desc,created_at desc
